$doc: pixelet's conventions over xpute's GPU calls (xpute/spec/gpu/api.json), which
the renderer writes through xpute's encoder (gpu/api.rs): the stream it writes
them into, its pipeline records' codes, and what a surface shows.
What a canvas the shell hands over shows (gpu/surface.rs): the world, or one thing in a case.
The one place the renderer's calls cross (gpu/api.rs): a stream
(xpute-guest ipc/stream.rs) in a range of the kernel's memory, which the
kernel writes its calls into during a turn and the host runs once the turn
has returned.
Its head is HEAD words, past the stream's END what the host writes for the
kernel: the device's block (xpute DEVICE) and the timed spans' read: its
word, then each span's begin and end ticks (gpu/api.rs lays them out and
holds this number to it).
The range's size: the stream, what one turn may send the device, then at
its end the encoder's handle table (gpu/api.rs), which zeroed bytes are an
empty one of. A product number, said rather than derived: a turn's uploads
wait (`room`) only when a burst of them comes at once.
What an upload leaves of the range. The records a turn cannot put off — a
frame's passes and draws, the shaders the first frame makes — are never
refused, so an upload, which can wait a turn, is taken only while this much
is left after it.
A pipeline record's codes (frame/shader/record.rs, expanded into xpute's
descriptors by gpu/api.rs), and HEAD, the words it opens with before its
vertex buffers. Then: the topology, the cull mode, the depth compare under
reversed Z (LESS is plain depth, for a depth-only pass; NO_DEPTH, no
depth attachment), the blend, which vertex entry point of
its shader the pipeline enters, a vertex step and format, and a binding's
kind (its stages are xpute's SHADER_STAGE) — TEXTURE_UNFILTERED a texture in a
format no sampler
filters (RGBA32F), read by textureLoad alone; TEXTURE_UINT_ARRAY a u32
texture's layers, read by textureLoad; STORAGE_TEXTURE_RW an r32uint
texture's layers read and written in place, the one format family WebGPU
lets a shader do both to; TEXTURE_3D a filtered volume (the air's,
gpu/atmosphere.rs); STORAGE_TEXTURE_3D an rgba16float volume a compute
pass writes.
